name: WebPlanetSoft AI Content Gen – Google Gemini AI Writer, SEO Blog Post & Content Generator
author: webplanetsoft

sections.description:
WebPlanetSoft AI Content Gen is the best solution to write blog posts instantly using the Google Gemini Free API. Whether you are a beginner or a developer, this plugin allows you to generate high-quality, human-like articles in seconds.

Stop staring at a blank screen. Just enter a topic, and our AI writer generates a comprehensive, SEO-optimized article with proper headings, introduction, and conclusion.

🚀 Why This is the Best Free AI Plugin?

Unlike other plugins that hide everything behind a paywall, our Free Version is packed with powerful features:

  • Google Gemini Powered: Uses the efficient Gemini 1.5 Flash model (Free API Key supported).
  • Smart Preview Vision: Exclusive Feature! Review the full generated content, including Meta Title, Meta Description, and the entire article body before saving. You see exactly what you get.
  • Yoast SEO Ready: The AI automatically generates a “Focus Keyphrase” and “Meta Description” that works seamlessly with Yoast to help you rank higher.
  • Intelligent Auto-Categorization: The plugin analyzes your topic and automatically assigns a relevant category. If the category doesn’t exist, it creates it for you!
  • Related Topic Logic: If you generate a topic that already exists, the AI is smart enough to create a unique variation to avoid duplication.
  • Clean Database: Optimized code ensures no junk data or uncertain spaces are left in your database.

Third-Party Service Disclosure:
This plugin uses the Google Gemini API to generate content.
* Service: Google Gemini (Generative AI)
* Terms of Use: Google Generative AI Terms
* Privacy Policy: Google Privacy Policy
* Data Sent: The “Topic” you enter is sent to Google’s servers to generate text. No other site data is shared.

🟢 Free Version Features (Lite)

  • AI Engine: Google Gemini (Free Tier).
  • Generation Mode: One-Click Manual Generation.
  • Content: Full Blog Posts with H2/H3 Tags.
  • SEO: Auto-fills Yoast SEO Meta Title, Description & Keywords.
  • Organization: Auto-creates Categories based on topic.
  • Review: “Draft” mode with full visual preview.
  • Logic: Smart handling of duplicate topics.

🔴 Premium Version Features (Pro)

  • AI Engine: Unlock ChatGPT (GPT-4) + Gemini.
  • Auto-Blogging: Fully Automatic Creation (Scheduler/Cron Job) to run on autopilot.
  • Bulk Mode: Generate 10, 50, or 100 articles at once.
  • Images: Auto-Generate AI Feature Images.
  • Custom Post Types: Support for WooCommerce, Real Estate, etc.
  • Targeting: Advanced category mapping.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the webplanet-ai-content-gen folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate via ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Go to WebPlanetSoft AI > Settings in your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Enter your Google Gemini API Key (A free key works perfectly).
  5. Go to WebPlanetSoft AI > Generate Content to start writing!
sections.faq:
Is this plugin really free to use?

Yes! The “Lite” version is completely free. It uses the Google Gemini Free Tier API, which allows you to generate a generous amount of content daily without any cost.

How do I get a Google Gemini API Key?

It is very easy. We have added a direct link inside the plugin.
1. Go to WebPlanetSoft AI > Settings.
2. Look for the “Get your Free Google Gemini API Key here” link under the API Key box.
3. Click it to open Google AI Studio and generate your free key instantly.

Does this plugin work with Yoast SEO?

Absolutely. We designed this plugin specifically to be Yoast SEO compatible. It automatically fills in the Focus Keyphrase and Meta Description fields so your content is ready to rank immediately.

Can I automatically schedule posts with this plugin?

The Free (Lite) version allows for Unlimited Manual Generation (one-click creation). If you need fully automated scheduling (auto-blogging on autopilot) or bulk generation, you will need to upgrade to the Pro Version.

Does generated content include images?

The Free version generates text-only content. The Pro Version includes an AI Image Generator that automatically creates and sets a Featured Image for your post.

Which languages does it support?

Since it is powered by Google Gemini, it supports over 40+ languages. You can simply type your topic in your desired language (e.g., “Receta de paella” or “WordPress Tipps Deutsch”), and the AI will generate the article in that language.
